mapper.select: SELECT * FROM cps_scoring_rule ORDER BY factory_calibration_flag ASC, rule_key ASC, version DESC

SELECT * FROM cps_scoring_rule WHERE rule_key = #{ruleKey} AND ( (#{factory} IS NULL AND factory IS NULL) OR (#{factory} IS NOT NULL AND factory = #{factory}) ) AND (effective_from IS NULL OR effective_from <= #{asOfDate}) AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= #{asOfDate}) ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM cps_scoring_rule WHERE rule_key = #{ruleKey} ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM cps_scoring_rule WHERE factory = #{factory} AND factory_calibration_flag = 1 ORDER BY rule_key ASC, version DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cps_scoring_rule ( rule_key, factory, rule_value, version, effective_from, effective_to, factory_calibration_flag, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{ruleKey}, #{factory}, #{ruleValue}, #{version}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveTo}, #{factoryCalibrationFlag}, #{updatedBy} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rule_value = VALUES(rule_value), version = VALUES(version), effective_from = VALUES(effective_from), effective_to = VALUES(effective_to), factory_calibration_flag = VALUES(factory_calibration_flag), updated_by = VALUES(updated_by)
